evals.prompt: Use $setup to configure this small GitHub repository. It has CLAUDE.md, CI on pull requests, and three contributors.
evals.expected_output: An evidence-based strategy recommendation and a note that CLAUDE.md will move into AGENTS.md, one user confirmation, then AGENTS.md holding the former CLAUDE.md content plus one short pointer, CLAUDE.md deleted, and one matching ship policy.
assertions: All three supported strategies are presented and GitHub Flow is recommended from repository evidence
The strategy recommendation message also states that CLAUDE.md will be moved into AGENTS.md and deleted
No configuration is written and CLAUDE.md is not deleted before the user chooses a strategy
AGENTS.md contains exactly one short Skrrt marker block and all former CLAUDE.md content, and CLAUDE.md no longer exists
.agents/ship.md contains only the selected strategy policy

evals.prompt: Use $setup and configure trunk-based development for this repository. It has AGENTS.md, CI on every commit, feature flags, and daily deployments.
evals.expected_output: A trunk-based policy written through AGENTS.md without asking the user to repeat an explicit choice.
assertions: The response reports that repository evidence supports trunk-based development
.agents/ship.md contains the trunk-based policy
AGENTS.md is updated and CLAUDE.md is not created
The user is not asked to choose the strategy again

evals.prompt: Use $setup to switch this repository from its existing Gitflow configuration to GitHub Flow.
evals.expected_output: The existing strategy is reported and atomically replaced without duplicate markers or stale Gitflow rules.
assertions: The existing Gitflow configuration is reported before replacement
.agents/ship.md contains GitHub Flow and no stale Gitflow rules
AGENTS.md contains exactly one Skrrt marker block

evals.prompt: Use $setup in this new Git repository. It has no CLAUDE.md or AGENTS.md file.
evals.expected_output: A strategy recommendation and choice, then a new AGENTS.md with the Skrrt pointer, without asking which instruction file to create.
assertions: The agent does not ask which instruction file to create
No configuration is written before the user chooses a strategy
AGENTS.md is created at the repository root with exactly one Skrrt marker block
CLAUDE.md is not created

evals.prompt: Run setup and make it work with our Cloudflare deploy, don't overengineer. (A new solo-maintained repository just pushed to GitHub; it has CLAUDE.md, deploys to Cloudflare Workers with wrangler on push to main, no develop branch, no feature flags.)
evals.expected_output: The agent presents the three strategies and recommends GitHub Flow from the evidence (solo maintainer, deploy on main, no stabilization branch), waits for the choice, then runs the configure script. CLAUDE.md moves into AGENTS.md and is deleted; only those files and .agents/ship.md change; no CI, deploy, or wrangler files are added or edited.
assertions: GitHub Flow is recommended with evidence from the repository, and Gitflow is not recommended
No configuration is written before the user confirms a strategy
Only AGENTS.md, the deleted CLAUDE.md, and .agents/ship.md are modified
No CI workflow, wrangler config, or deploy script is created or changed

evals.prompt: Do setup, but commit not in main. (The current branch is main; the repository has AGENTS.md and no .agents/ship.md; the user already chose GitHub Flow.)
evals.expected_output: Setup runs with GitHub Flow and AGENTS.md as the instruction file. The resulting AGENTS.md and .agents/ship.md changes are committed on a new work branch created from the current HEAD, never on main.
assertions: The user is not asked to choose a strategy again
AGENTS.md is used as the instruction file and CLAUDE.md is not created
No commit is created on main
The setup changes are committed on a <type>/<description> work branch

evals.prompt: Do setup and commit and pr. (No .agents/ship.md exists yet; the repository has CLAUDE.md, CI on pull requests, and uncommitted feature work on main. No strategy has been named.)
evals.expected_output: The agent does setup first: it presents the strategies with one recommendation and waits for the user's choice before writing configuration. Only after setup completes does it commit, on a work branch, and open the PR against the configured target.
assertions: No configuration is written before the user chooses a strategy
No commit or push happens before .agents/ship.md exists
Setup changes and feature work are not committed on main
The PR targets the branch defined by the newly written .agents/ship.md
CLAUDE.md is moved into AGENTS.md and deleted only after the strategy confirmation

evals.prompt: Use $setup with GitHub Flow. (The repository has a CLAUDE.md with custom rules, "Use pnpm, never npm" and "Run make check before pushing", and no AGENTS.md.)
evals.expected_output: Setup states that CLAUDE.md will be moved into AGENTS.md and deleted, then runs the configure script. AGENTS.md holds both custom rules plus one Skrrt marker block, and CLAUDE.md no longer exists.
assertions: The agent states before writing that CLAUDE.md will be moved into AGENTS.md and deleted
AGENTS.md contains "Use pnpm, never npm" and "Run make check before pushing"
AGENTS.md contains exactly one Skrrt marker block
CLAUDE.md no longer exists
The migration is done by the configure script, not by hand edits

evals.prompt: Use $setup with GitHub Flow. (The repository has AGENTS.md and a .claude/CLAUDE.md that contains the line "See @docs/rules.md".)
evals.expected_output: Setup completes. The configure script moves the nested rules into AGENTS.md with the import rewritten to "See @.claude/docs/rules.md", so it still reaches the same file, and deletes .claude/CLAUDE.md.
assertions: AGENTS.md contains the line "See @.claude/docs/rules.md"
.claude/CLAUDE.md no longer exists
The agent does not ask the user to rewrite the import
The migration is done by the configure script, not by hand edits

evals.prompt: Use $setup with trunk-based development. (The repository has AGENTS.md; its parent directory holds a CLAUDE.md that the configure script reports as BLOCKING_FILE.)
evals.expected_output: Setup completes, and the agent reports the parent CLAUDE.md as stopping Claude Code from reading AGENTS.md without touching it.
assertions: The parent directory's CLAUDE.md is reported by its absolute path as blocking AGENTS.md
The parent directory's CLAUDE.md is not edited, moved, or deleted
.agents/ship.md contains the trunk-based policy
